failed_all_in_harness_cleanup.interpretation: The schema invariants fire exactly as specified - they block precisely the mutations the spec forbids, including against the test harness itself. The failures are test-harness cleanup-mechanics defects (app-role cleanup cannot delete/rewrite immutable rows), not schema bugs. Deferred to wave 2 per D12.
